visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a man in a black shirt and glasses performing dramatic, anime-style martial arts poses against a swirling, neon-orange and black vortex background. He holds his hands as if gripping an invisible sword, grimacing and squinting with intensity as if preparing for a battle against an unseen foe. (2) The scene cuts to a well-lit studio with a large wooden bookshelf. The man holds a yellow electric mosquito swatter, swinging it through the air with exaggerated force. An animated mosquito is superimposed on the screen, which he attempts to attack as he looks focused and determined, his body lunging forward. (3) The man then stands in the studio, holding the swatter and pointing toward its handle. He removes a plastic cover to reveal two AA batteries inside. He looks directly at the camera with an inquisitive expression, gesturing with his free hand to emphasize his query about how low-voltage batteries can kill a mosquito. (4) A technical breakdown follows, showing a close-up of a disassembled swatter. His finger points to specific electronic components on a green PCB, including a red capacitor and a yellow transformer. Overlays show mathematical formulas and diagrams of plasma fields destroying pathogens while he explains the internal mechanics. (5) In the final phase, the man presents a large black rectangular appliance, the Clean Station CS101 MAX. He demonstrates inserting a metal filter module into a slot. The screen displays technical energy labels and finally a promotional screen with a price and brand logo, while he smiles and gives a thumbs up.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy male narrator speaks rapidly with a bright, enunciated tone. Underneath, a fast-paced electronic synth track with a steady kick drum beat plays. The sound field is extremely clean. (2) A sharp, synthesized 'whoosh' sound effect triggers simultaneously with a digital 'zap' impact sound, mimicking the sound of an electric shock. The narrator's pitch rises as he delivers an enthusiastic opening. (3) The music volume ducks slightly as the narrator shifts to a more instructional, moderate pitch while explaining battery voltage. A high-pitched 'ding' SFX punctuates the mention of specific components. (4) As the technical explanation continues, the synth music remains constant but a subtle low-end riser SFX builds tension. The narrator maintains high speech density without pausing. (5) The narrator's voice becomes more authoritative and promotional. Mechanical 'click' sounds are heard as he interacts with the appliance. The music swells to a peak with a final digital stinger SFX as the brand name is mentioned.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video utilizes a popular science (STEM) approach to explain the high-voltage physics behind electric mosquito swatters, leveraging this educational hook to introduce and endorse the Clean Station CS101 MAX air purifier's plasma sterilization technology.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of the product, display of pricing and discounts, and a call to action link provided in the captions.
